subject: SOW & PO routing for Azure private plan - next steps
messages:
From: Jane Carter <jane.carter@blueedge.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@blueedge.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOW updates + PO routing for Redwood private plan

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

Thanks for the call this morning. We're excited to move the pilot forward. A couple of asks from procurement before we can issue the PO: 

1) Can you send the latest SOW (clean + tracked) that reflects the 6-month pilot scope we discussed? We need the milestone language to match our internal SOW template.
2) Procurement prefers the PO to name the payee as "Redwood Inference, Inc." and include a remit-to address on the invoice. If marketplace billing is required for entitlements, we still need a PO on file labeled as "PO-BlueEdge-45123" for our internal approvals.
3) There are two contract points we need explicit confirmation on: indemnity cap (our standard is $1,000,000) and a data residency statement that all customer data will remain in US regions.

I've attached our PO template (BlueEdge_PO_45123.pdf) for reference. If you can return a SOW and a brief note on PO/invoice routing we can kick off procurement review.

Appreciate it,

Jane Carter
Head of Procurement
BlueEdge
Procurement: procurement@blueedge.com

(attachment: BlueEdge_PO_45123.pdf)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Carter <jane.carter@blueedge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T12:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW updates + PO routing for Redwood private plan

Jane — thanks for the clear list. Attaching Redwood_SOW_v3.docx (clean) and a tracked redline we will follow up with if needed. Quick answers inline: 

- SOW: attached (Redwood_SOW_v3.docx). This reflects the 6-month pilot, two milestones (kickoff + pilot review), and the acceptance criteria we discussed.
- PO naming: we can accept PO-BlueEdge-45123. For Azure private plan entitlements, the marketplace will provision entitlements, but you can still issue a PO for internal approval purposes. We'll work with finance to ensure the invoice includes the remit-to details you need.
- Indemnity & data residency: looping in Lauren for final legal confirmation. Our standard indemnity cap is $1,000,000 for pilots; we will include the data residency clause indicating processing within US regions for BlueEdge.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Lauren to confirm redlines / provide Commercial_Redlines_v2.pdf with comments.
2) Marissa to confirm co-sell/rev share and whether you prefer marketplace-anchored billing or direct invoicing for the pilot.
3) I will upload the SOW to DocuSign and send a signing link once legal signs off.

Matt — sorry, typo — Mateo (autocorrect).

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

(attachment: Redwood_SOW_v3.docx)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW updates + PO routing for Redwood private plan

Hi team,

Reviewed the SOW and BlueEdge PO template. High-level:

- Indemnity cap: we'll accept $1,000,000 for this pilot. Add a 12-month claim window and carve-outs for gross negligence as discussed.
- Data residency: add explicit language in Section 4.2: "All customer data will be processed and stored in US data centers for the duration of the engagement." We'll add an audit-rights paragraph limited to scope of entitlements.
- Invoicing / PO routing: procurement's PO should reference "Redwood Inference, Inc." We will provide Redwood's remit-to on the invoice. For marketplace-entitled billing, include an internal note on the invoice referencing the Azure private plan entitlement ID to reconcile.

I've attached the commercial redlines (Commercial_Redlines_v2.pdf) with tracked comments on the SOW and a suggested minor change to the payment term to Net 45 for enterprise pilot. Please review.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

(attachment: Commercial_Redlines_v2.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Carter <jane.carter@blueedge.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@blueedge.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW updates + PO routing for Redwood private plan

Hi Jane — thanks for sending the PO template. Quick note from GTM on the entitlement/billing side to make procurement's life easier: 

- For the pilot we can do one of two flows (your choice):
  1) Marketplace-entitled: Azure will provision entitlements to BlueEdge and charge through Microsoft with a visible line for Redwood. This is the cleanest long-term approach and preserves marketplace incentives/co-sell. You'll still be able to attach PO-BlueEdge-45123 for internal tracking; we will include the entitlement ID on our invoice.
  2) Direct invoice: Redwood issues a one-time invoice to BlueEdge (PO-BlueEdge-45123) for the pilot amount. We can support this to accelerate procurement but it will be an exception to standard marketplace entitlements.

- Revenue share / co-sell: No change to pricing for the pilot. Marketplace entitlements enable the typical channel settlement. If you opt for direct invoice, we will reconcile co-sell credits post-pilot.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Jane confirms preferred billing flow (Marketplace-entitled strongly recommended).
2) Mateo to upload the SOW to DocuSign — I will include the commercial redlines Lauren provided. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?s=example-envelope-id-12345
3) Procurement attaches signed PO (PO-BlueEdge-45123) and confirms remit-to address.

If you confirm marketplace-entitled, we will provide the entitlement ID and a short invoice reconciliation note. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

(attachment: none)

From: Jane Carter <jane.carter@blueedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@blueedge.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW updates + PO routing for Redwood private plan

Marissa / Mateo — thanks for the quick turn. Procurement confirms we will choose the marketplace-entitled flow to keep accounting consistent. We have reviewed Lauren's redlines and accept the indemnity cap of $1,000,000 and the data residency language as outlined.

I've attached the signed PO (BlueEdge_PO_45123.pdf). Please confirm the entitlement ID once created and the remit-to address for our AP team to set up.

Jane Carter
Head of Procurement
BlueEdge
procurement@blueedge.com

(attachment: BlueEdge_PO_45123.pdf)
